scripts.test: bun test app/src bridge/src shared scripts/mutate.test.ts scripts/assert-nav-dots.test.ts scripts/oss-loop.test.ts scripts/phone-install.test.ts scripts/keep-going.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun app/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p app --noEmit && bun bridge/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p bridge --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit
scripts.spec: python3 spec/check.py && python3 -I -m unittest discover -s spec -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.spec:law: python3 -I -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -I tests/feature_completion_parity.py && python3 -I tests/feature_completion_mutation.py
